tokens.SYSTEM_REMINDER_CLOUD_REVIEW_LAUNCH_NOTE: Runtime value (the user's launch note, sanitised by Wt(ne(h, …))). Renders `This review was launched with a note: "<note>". The cloud review did not see it.` The trim only cut ", recorded at launch time" before the colon; the quoted note is still introduced as the launch note.

tokens.PLAN_FILE_PATH: Runtime value (the plan file path). Renders `Saved plan: <path>` as a label/value line, followed by TEAM_PARALLELIZATION_NOTE, which resolves to "" or "\n\nIf this plan can be broken down …", so it never runs into the path.
